description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various relational categories within the MMRA benchmark, which evaluates multi-granularity and multi-image relational association capabilities in large visual language models. The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each representing a different relational type with its corresponding count and percentage of the total. The largest segment, labeled "126 (12.28%)", is colored light green and represents the most frequent category. Other notable categories include "SimilarMaterial" (106, 10.33%, orange), "SubEvent" (100, 9.74%, red), and "UsageSimilarity" (100, 9.65%, brown). Several categories, such as "NearSameEntity" (63, 6.34%, dark gray), "RelativePosition" (81, 7.90%, light gray), "MentalitySimilarity" (89, 8.67%, light cyan), "SimilarEvent" (90, 8.77%, light blue), "AppearanceSimilarity" (90, 8.77%, light green), "Environment" (90, 8.77%, dark teal), and "Layout" (90, 8.77%, pale yellow), are also displayed with their respective values and percentages. Each segment is clearly labeled with its name, count, and percentage, and the colors are used to differentiate the categories, with the segments arranged in a clockwise direction around the chart.
